subject: Rook - Redirect - what happens to the new line characters?

messages.author: 6823ad2e5eae806b
messages.subject: Rook - Redirect - what happens to the new line characters?
parts:
I've been using Rook recently with the idea of using it as a simple
reporting front end.

The user chooses 2 dates and a ticker, clicks submit, then a googleVis
chart is rendered. I'm almost there, except for one annoying issue.

Redirect in Rook appears to remove all new line chars, which means
that the comments in the googleVis javascript cause the chart to
break. For example:

// jsFunction
function x

becomes

// jsFunction function x

Any idea what I could do to get it working? I have tested it with the
brew example files (apple stock) and get the same problem via Rook
redirects. Any help would be much appreciated.

This is my setup:

startWebServer.R
==============

require("Rook")
s<-Rhttpd$new()
s$start(listen='0.0.0.0', port=8080, quiet=TRUE)
s$add(name="Test App", app=Builder$new(
Brewery$new(url="/",root="C:/FundamentalDB/brew/"),
Redirect$new("/test.html")))

test.html
================

<html>
<head>
<meta http-equiv="Content-Type" content="text/html; charset=utf-8">
</head>
<body>

<form method="GET" action="#">
From date: <input type="text" name="fromDate" /><br/>
To date: <input type="text" name="toDate" /> <br/>
Ticker: <input type="text" name="ticker" /> <br/>
<input type="submit" value="Submit" />
</form>

<% brew('exampleResults.rhtml') %>

</body>
</html>

exampleResults.rhtml
===================

<%
require(googleVis)
if (is.null(req$GET)) return()
GET <- req$GET()
ticker<-GET$ticker

fromDate<-as.Date(GET$fromDate, "%Y-%m-%d")
toDate<-as.Date(GET$toDate, "%Y-%m-%d")
URL <- paste("http://ichart.finance.yahoo.com/table.csv?s=", ticker,
sep="")
dat <- read.csv(URL, colClasses=c("Date", rep("numeric",6)))
dat$Date <- as.Date(dat$Date, "%Y-%m-%d")
dat<-dat[dat$Date >= fromDate & dat$Date <= toDate, ]
dat[order(dat$Date),]<-dat
g<-gvisAnnotatedTimeLine(dat, datevar="Date", numvar="Close")
cat(g$html$chart, file="tempChart.htm")

%>

<%= g$html$chart %>

Actually, it's not Redirect's fault. Rather, it's the way
textConnections are implemented which is what capture.output uses,
which is what Brewery uses. It's definitely a bug, and I just fixed it
here:

https://github.com/jeffreyhorner/Rook/tree/master/Rook

Let me know if that doesn't work.

Jeff
